title: apicra reticulata
intro: Apicra reticulata, commonly known as the desert marigold or desert gold poppy, is a flowering plant native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Apicra reticulata include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been shown to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to calm the nervous system and relieve anxiety, and its bioactive constituents include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
